## Types and classes
```{r}
typeof(1.5)
typeof("toto")
typeof('also between single quotes')
typeof(TRUE)
typeof(1L)
typeof(1)
typeof(typeof)
typeof(list())
```

A type defines a set (math way) with associated operations.


### Classes
```{r}
data(iris)
typeof(iris)
class(iris)
```

Classes is the way to create your own type. Classes is what you create, type is your environement (= what is given to you).
Not much classes. 
2 ways to create classes 
- from a list
- from a vector
